# Fish pickup, 0.42 m, nose -Y. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Fish --base-color 0.769 0.941 0.761 --no-slot
material new Fin --base-color 0.353 0.725 0.659 --no-slot
add mesh uv-sphere --name Body --segments 6 --rings 4 --radius 0.5 --location 0 -0.04 0
scale 0.1 0.3 0.17
apply --scale
material assign Fish
add mesh cone --name Tail --vertices 4 --radius1 0.11 --radius2 0 --depth 0.14 --location 0 0.15 0 --rotation 90 45 0
apply --rotation
scale 0.5 1 1.1
apply --scale
material assign Fin
select all
active Body
join
rename Body Fish
shade flat
export fish.glb
